trigger: Moraine wall breach triggered by continuous cloudburst rainfall & ice avalanche displacement wave
damage: Washed away 1,200 MW Chungthang Hydro Dam (Teesta-III), 40+ bridges destroyed, 100+ fatalities, severed NH-10 connectivity
key_lesson: Need for automated water level sensor telemetry and early warning acoustic sirens downstream

trigger: Catastrophic rock and hanging ice avalanche from Ronti Peak crashing into valley floor, mobilizing massive slurry flood
damage: Destroyed Rishiganga HEP, severely damaged Tapovan Vishnugad HEP tunnel, 204 casualties
key_lesson: Steep hanging glacier walls in high-altitude permafrost zones require thermal satellite monitoring

trigger: Excessive monsoon precipitation coupled with rapid snowmelt filled Chorabari Lake beyond moraine crest capacity
damage: Over 5,000 fatalities, devastating destruction of Kedarnath township, Rambara, and downstream pilgrim routes
key_lesson: Moraine morass dams have very low shear strength under sudden saturation and hydrostatic surge

trigger: Moraine dam failure in Tibet sending transboundary flood surge down into Nepal
damage: Damaged Upper Bhotekoshi Hydroelectric Plant, destroyed Friendship Bridge at Tatopani border crossing
key_lesson: Cross-border transboundary early warning sharing protocol is indispensable in the Himalayas

trigger: Partial collapse of end-moraine dam from hydrostatic pressure
damage: Flooded downstream Punakha valley, 21 casualties, severely threatened ancient Punakha Dzong
key_lesson: Manual and mechanical drainage channels must be carved to control lake freeboard
